subject: Request: KMS snapshot, rotation evidence, and BYOK provenance
messages:
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@certifysecure.com>
To: marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: security@certifysecure.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: KMS snapshot & rotation evidence request for SOC 2 readiness

Marcus —

Finera is starting an internal readiness run ahead of our SOC 2 timeline and our auditor (CertifySecure) asked us to get a bundle of KMS/hsm artifacts from Redwood. Can you help us gather the following by Tuesday 2027-06-14?

Requested items (priority order):
1) Current KMS key inventory snapshot (key IDs, creation dates, current primary key version, key policy id)
2) Key rotation logs for the last 12 months (time, key ID, previous/new version, operator id)
3) HSM attestation/certification chain (FIPS/Module vendor attestation, firmware versions)
4) BYOK handshake events for any tenant-managed keys (timestamped events for key uploads/rotations and verification steps)
5) Any KEK/wrapping lineage docs or exportability notes (how KEKs are wrapped/unwrapped)

Format preference: CSV for logs, PEM or PDF for attestations, JSON for BYOK events. If you can provide a secure share (S3 presigned or Drive link) that works. Also let us know any PII/username redaction you typically apply — auditor prefers hashed operator IDs if possible.

If this is the wrong contact, please point us to the right person on your side. Happy to set a short call if that speeds things up.

Thanks,
Tom Reynolds
Senior Security Engineer
CertifySecure
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@certifysecure.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 7 Jun 2027 11:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: KMS snapshot & rotation evidence request for SOC 2 readiness

Tom —

Thanks for the clear list. We can produce everything you requested. I'm looping in Irene (Security/Compliance) and Laura (Customer Success) to coordinate the bundle and access method. A couple quick clarifications so we scope the deliverable correctly: 

- For operator identifiers: would hashed operator IDs (SHA256 truncated) be acceptable? We can also provide a mapping under NDA if the auditor needs to map to actual usernames.
- For BYOK, do you need the full handshake payloads or only the event metadata (time, key id, verification result)? We can redact tenant-identifying fields if required.

Proposed timeline:
- Initial bundle (inventory + rotation CSV + BYOK event JSON + HSM attestation PEM) delivered to a secure Drive link by end of day Wed 2027-06-09.
- Follow-ups and any additional export (e.g., signed statements) on Thu/Fri.

If that works I'll have Irene prepare the exports and Laura confirm delivery logistics (S3 presigned vs Drive). Also happy to do a 20-minute call tomorrow to walk through the artifacts — propose 2027-06-08 10:00 PT if that helps.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Principal, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@certifysecure.com>, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 8 Jun 2027 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: KMS snapshot & rotation evidence request for SOC 2 readiness

Hi Tom / Marcus —

Irene from Redwood Security here. Quick tech note on the artifacts we'll include in the initial bundle: 

- KMS inventory snapshot: CSV with columns (key_id, alias, created_at, primary_version, policy_id, is_exportable). No plaintext tenant identifiers will be in this file; tenant ids will be pseudonymized as tenant_xxx.
- Rotation log (CSV): columns (event_time_utc, key_id, old_version, new_version, operator_hash). Operator_hash is SHA256 truncated to 12 hex chars. If CertifySecure needs the full mapping we can provide it under an MSA amendment or via secure NDA mapping.
- BYOK events (JSON): each event will include (ts, key_id, event_type{upload/verify/rotate}, verification_status). We will redact tenant-specific payloads and include correlation IDs for auditor reference.
- HSM attestation: PEM chain from our HSM vendor plus a short human-readable attestation summary (firmware, FIPS level, slot protection) in PDF.
- Key custodianship statement: short signed PDF stating Redwood's custody model for hosted keys and the procedures for emergency key rotation/escrow.

Delivery: we'll put the initial bundle in a restricted Google Drive folder and send a one-time access link (auditor emails will be added). For higher security we can generate a presigned S3 URL with IP restriction if you prefer.

Attachments we'll include in the bundle: kms_inventory_snapshot_20270607.csv, rotation_log_2026-06-01_2027-06-07.csv, byok_handshake_events_202703-202706.json, hsm_attestation_chain_20270607.pem, redwood_key_custodianship_statement.pdf

Let me know if hashed operator IDs are ok; we can also provide a redaction summary that lists which fields were removed/hashed.

Regards,
Irene Choi
Head of Security Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@certifysecure.com>
To: irene.choi@redwood.com, marcus.lin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 10:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: KMS snapshot & rotation evidence request for SOC 2 readiness

Irene / Marcus —

This is great, thanks. A couple of follow-ups from the auditor after reviewing your plan: 

- Can you include the HSM attestation chain as both PEM and a signed PDF summary (we want the chain for automated validation and a PDF for human review).
- Retention question: please confirm retention windows for rotation logs (we expect at least 13 months).
- For the key custodianship statement, can you add a short paragraph explicitly naming the parties authorized to initiate emergency key rotation and the escalation path (email + phone) used for emergency processes?

If you can add those items to the bundle that will probably close most of our open questions. We'll review the bundle when it arrives and come back with any clarifications.

Thanks — we'll plan to review and then schedule time if needed.

Tom
CertifySecure
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>
To: Tom Reynolds <tom.reynolds@certifysecure.com>
Cc: irene.choi@redwood.com, laura.bennett@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 9 Jun 2027 17:45:00 -0700
Subject: Re: KMS snapshot & rotation evidence request for SOC 2 readiness

Tom —

Thanks — we've updated the bundle per your notes. Delivery and contents below: 

Delivery: secure Google Drive folder (one-time access). Link: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1aB_example_shared_drive_link (access granted to security@certifysecure.com and audit@finerasystems.com). If you prefer S3 with IP restrictions, tell me the egress IP and we'll provision.

Included (attached in the bundle):
- kms_inventory_snapshot_20270607.csv (CSV: key_id, alias, created_at, primary_version, policy_id, is_exportable)
- rotation_log_2026-06-01_2027-06-07.csv (CSV: event_time_utc, key_id, old_version, new_version, operator_hash)
- byok_handshake_events_202703-202706.json (JSON event list; tenant payloads redacted)
- hsm_attestation_chain_20270607.pem (PEM chain)
- hsm_attestation_summary_20270607.pdf (signed PDF summary — firmware, FIPS level, vendor attestation)
- redwood_key_custodianship_statement.pdf (signed; includes authorized roles and 24/7 emergency escalation phone + email)

Retention note: rotation logs are retained for 18 months by default; we can export older data on request if you need a longer window.

Next steps: please confirm receipt and whether the Drive link works for your auditor. If you want the operator mapping we can set up a separate secure transfer under an NDA amendment. I also scheduled a 20-minute sync for tomorrow 10:00 PT in case you want to walk through artifacts (calendar invite sent).

Best regards,
Marcus Lin
Principal, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: kms_inventory_snapshot_20270607.csv; rotation_log_2026-06-01_2027-06-07.csv; byok_handshake_events_202703-202706.json; hsm_attestation_chain_20270607.pem; hsm_attestation_summary_20270607.pdf; redwood_key_custodianship_statement.pdf
